events.description: Completed the acquisition of Hero on October 13, 2022, for a cash purchase price of $546.8 million (net of cash acquired), with $400.0 million allocated to the trade name.
events.source_quote: On October 13, 2022, we completed the Hero Acquisition. Hero is included in our results since the date of acquisition.

events.description: Completed the acquisition of the TheraBreath brand of oral care products business (Dr. Harold Katz, LLC and HK-IP International, Inc.) on December 24, 2021, for $556.0 million, net of cash acquired, and deferred an additional cash payment of $14.0 million related to indemnity obligations.
events.source_quote: On December 24, 2021, the Company acquired all of the outstanding equity of Dr. Harold Katz, LLC and HK-IP International, Inc. , the owners of the THERABREATH® brand of oral care products business (the “TheraBreath Acquisition”).  The Company paid $ 556.0 , net of cash acquired, at closing and deferred an additional cash payment of $ 14.0 related to certain indemnity obligations provided by the seller.

events.description: Declared and paid quarterly cash dividends of $0.27 per common share in Q2 2023 (representing $0.54 per share for the first six months of 2023, up from $0.53 in 2022).

Repaid $200.0 million on the Term Loan due December 22, 2024 during the first half of 2023, reducing the outstanding balance from $400.0 million as of December 31, 2022, to $200.0 million as of June 30, 2023.
